name: SkyWatch EarthCache
short: One API to search and task satellite imagery from many providers.
summary: SkyWatch Space Applications (Canada) runs EarthCache, an aggregator of satellite, aerial and open imagery from many providers behind one REST API (api.skywatch.co/earthcache, x-api-key), a public keyless MCP endpoint for search and pricing, and a signed-in MCP server (mcp.skywatch.com, OAuth) that can place archive and tasking orders. Tasking orders (offering search, cost calculation, then a pipeline order) need a window of at least 7 days and are placed at least 2 days before start.

tasks: search the imagery archive by polygon, date, cloud cover and resolution (REST, WebSocket, MCP)
calculate price and probability of collection before ordering
browse offerings and configurations for a location (search by partner, category archive or tasking)
order archive imagery and create tasking orders (future captures, recurring interval of 7 days or more) as pipelines
webhooks on pipeline events; AOI monitors; DirectView/WMTS tiles

pricing.model: per km2 by offering and resolution; quoted by the price calculator
pricing.notes: No public rate card found. Docs: tasking requires max_cost taken from the cost calculator; archive minimum AOI above 1 km2; Sentinel-2 is free; 'Orders are machine-to-machine, no refunds'.

latency.typical: Tasking: order at least 2 days before start; minimum window 7 days
latency.notes: Docs: 'Place taskings at least 2 days before start to allow provider scheduling/cancellation if needed'; cannot cancel within 48 hours of start; fulfilment treated as complete at about 80-85% AOI coverage. Delivery times per offering are not stated in the docs read.

regions: Global, subject to each provider's offerings
coverage.notes: Docs: missing offerings mean 'access restrictions or provider constraints (territory, embargo, high/low demand regions)'. SAR, elevation and some Airbus/Planet configurations are 'Non-Standard' and need coordination with support before ordering.

licensing.summary: No SkyWatch imagery licence or terms of service was found on skywatch.com or the docs site (the site footer lists only privacy and cookie policies). Imagery comes from third-party providers whose own licences presumably apply; SkyWatch's rights terms are not stated here. Resale, AI training and ownership are therefore left unstated.

human.unknown: Captured by satellites or aircraft of the underlying providers; no person is identity-checked.

application.unknown: No attestation of delivered files is documented.

camera.unknown: Not a signed capture, so none (STANDARD §3). Offerings and search results carry provider and sensor metadata passed through from the operator.

time.unknown: Search results carry capture timestamps from the provider; no independent check documented.

location.unknown: Results have footprints and GeoTIFF outputs; georeferencing accuracy is not stated.

content.unknown: No integrity or anti-manipulation method is documented.

corroboration.unknown: No cross-provider checking is documented, though the MCP search has a compare_providers mode a buyer could use.

freshness.typical_age: Archive: whatever exists; tasking: captured after you order inside a window of 7 days or more
freshness.notes: Archive search and tasking share one order API.

auth.how_to_get: Add https://mcp.skywatch.com/mcp to an MCP client and sign in with a SkyWatch Explore (free, self-service) or Hub account. The authorization server advertises client_id_metadata_document_supported, public clients (token auth none) and S256 PKCE, but no registration_endpoint, so an agent cannot self-register by RFC 7591. Explore accounts can order archive imagery and standard tasking; the assistant shows price and asks to confirm before ordering.
Log in to a SkyWatch Hub account, open account settings and copy the API key (no 'Bearer' prefix). Hub accounts are by invitation from an organisation admin per the MCP docs.
Public MCP v1 endpoint https://api.skywatch.co/mcp needs no account: search_archive_imagery, calculate_pricing, get_satellites, get_offerings only.

endpoints.params: location (required), resolution_low, resolution_high, product_name, partner_name, category archive|tasking
resolution, location, start_date, end_date, interval, product.configuration.offering_id
name, future dates, max_cost from calculator, interval >= 7d, aoi, output geotiff, product.configuration.offering_id

api.rate_limits: Not stated in the docs read (limits-errors page covers geometry and cost rules only).

mcp.auth: OAuth sign-in with a SkyWatch account, S256 PKCE, scope offline_access, no dynamic registration endpoint advertised
mcp.notes: Not in the official MCP Registry (search=skywatch returned 0). Unsigned: 5 tools. Explore accounts: 24 tools including ordering. The older public server at https://api.skywatch.co/mcp answered a JSON-RPC initialize without credentials (server skywatch-mcp-server 1.0.0).

api.notes: Constraints from llms.txt: single polygon only, max 500 vertices recommended, tasking output geotiff with mosaic unstitched, min_aoi_coverage_percentage typically 85 or less.

delivery.basis: Docs: 'Minimum interval: 7 days' and 'Place orders at least 2 days before start'.

payment.notes: Docs list a payment-methods API and budgets per project, and the MCP says orders charge the account after a confirmed price; the actual methods (card, invoice, credits) were not itemised in the pages read, so this list is the Hub/Explore norm, not verified.

requester.checks: Account sign-in; Hub roles Reader, Creator and SuperAdmin decide who can order; SuperAdmin approves orders waiting for approval.
requester.unknown: Whether SkyWatch screens buyers (identity, sanctions, end use) is not documented in the pages read.
